text:
maria: quick sync — qbench on q6b-int4 surfaced a weird duplication pattern in the promptset we use for golden. seems quantization-induced paraphrase collapse + tokenizer normalisation are causing duplicates across anchors. tagging @labeling-team :eyes:
jon: can you paste an example? is it exact dup or semantically same?
maria: short example — two samples got collapsed after int4 kernels. original: "Order status for order #12345" and paraphrase: "Where is my order 12345?". After token remap they hash identical for our dedupe fingerprint.
alex: that's bad. our dedupe step uses fingerprint v3 which expects tokenizer v2. if quant change affects tokenization boundaries we need to re-run fingerprinting.
maria: agreed. how expensive is re-fingerprint across the 400k promptbank?
tara: estimate ~6 hrs on current shard workers, or ~1.5 hrs if we parallelize across 4 workers. cost ~ $50 in spot.
sam: we also need to update golden annotations for impacted anchors — some golden labels are model-specific (longform summarization). can ops-bot export the list?
ops-bot: export job queued: `export_promptset --name promptbank-v3 --filter "fingerprint_conflict=true" --out s3://redwood-temp/q6b-fp-conflicts.json` (job id: 2449)
jon: maria, can you add a small reproducible snippet to the repo, and a short PR that includes a script to re-run fingerprints + a dry-run mode (no write)? keeps ops comfortable.
maria: will do. planning to run a targeted re-fingerprint on the flagged anchors first, then a full run after we confirm no regressions.
tara: labelers — heads up: when we re-fingerprint some samples may re-enter the labeling queue as duplicates get reshuffled. contractor queues might see burst.
sam: contractor lead pinged — they'll prep extra reviewers for a few hours tomorrow. also need a checklist so they don't accidentally overwrite golden labels.
alex: checklist idea: (1) read-only mode by default, (2) golden changes require two approvers, (3) record diff patch in git + provenance tag.
maria: exactly. i'll draft the checklist and post in #help on Friday. also adding a one-off eval to compute model regression after re-fingerprint: `python eval/regression_check.py --model q6b-int4 --gold s3://...`
jon: any chance we can avoid full re-run by tweaking fingerprint to be tolerant of token boundary shifts? maybe use character-level rolling hash with window=7 as fallback.
tara: that might reduce conflicts but could increase false merges. worth a small A/B test. set up experiment on 10k sample slice.
sam: contractor ops — can you schedule reviewers for the A/B slice and the full rescue window?
ops-bot: calendar invite created for "q6b-int4 promptbank rescue" tomorrow 10:00-13:00 PT.
maria: thanks. i'll open a PR with scripts + sampleset and link it here. expected PR by EOD today. :thumbsup:
jon: great — once PR is up i'll run the A/B and share metrics (duplicate rate, label churn, eval delta).
ara: (joining late) curious — are we confident this only affects int4 kernel? any chance earlier quant profiles also shift tokenization?
maria: good call. initial diffs point to the int4 kernel tokenizer mapping change in runtime v1.3.0. we'll run a tiny sweep across int8 and fp16 to verify.
jon: ok. next steps recap: maria PR + A/B slice (10k) run, tara coordinate labeler capacity, sam manage contractor approvals, alex draft two-approver golden process, ops-bot export full conflict list. aim to triage by EOD tomorrow.
maria: yup. updating thread as I push PRs and results.
jon: thanks everyone. :sparkles:
